process.title: Four simple steps to a fair price
process.description: Based on 24,650 quote requests processed in 2025 [EM-VERIFIED], most owners receive a competitive offer within 5.2 days from start to finish.

steps.title: Submit your enquiry
steps.description: Enter your registration, mileage, and a short description. Takes a few minutes - completely free.

steps.title: We match you
steps.description: Your anonymised enquiry is shared with relevant specialists from our network of 100+ UK suppliers.

steps.title: Receive & compare
steps.description: You'll typically get 3-5 quotes within a few hours, direct from suppliers.

steps.title: You choose
steps.description: No obligation. You decide which supplier to contact, ask questions, and proceed if you're happy.

trust.title: Honesty is the foundation of trust
trust.description: We are transparent about our marketplace model, our data, and our limitations. We do not claim to be a garage or a warranty provider. We are a comparison platform - and we believe that honesty is the foundation of trust.

items.question: What does Engines Market do- +
items.answer: Engines Market is a price comparison platform that connects you with independent UK engine suppliers. We help you compare quotes from vetted specialists to find a fair price for engine replacement.

items.question: How does the engine replacement quote process work- +
items.answer: You submit your enquiry online. We match you with relevant specialists from our network of 100+ UK suppliers. You will typically receive 3-5 quotes within a few hours, then you choose the supplier that best fits your needs.

items.question: Is Engines Market a garage or engine seller- +
items.answer: No. Engines Market is a comparison platform. We do not sell engines, fit engines, provide warranties, or handle payments. All contracts are directly between you and the supplier you choose.

items.question: How much does it cost to use Engines Market- +
items.answer: It is completely free for drivers. We do not charge you anything to submit an enquiry or receive quotes. Our revenue comes from suppliers who pay a small fee to be part of our network.

items.question: How do you vet your suppliers- +
items.answer: We vet suppliers based on their UK business registration, trading history, customer reviews, and adherence to our supplier standards. We regularly review supplier performance to maintain quality.
